title: Test Classes
description: Browse material test data organized by test type

tensile.name: Tensile Testing
tensile.description: Measure ultimate tensile strength, yield strength, and elongation

compression.name: Compression Testing
compression.description: Evaluate compressive strength and modulus properties

hardness.name: Hardness Testing
hardness.description: Measure material hardness using Rockwell, Brinell, or Vickers scales

impact.name: Impact Testing
impact.description: Assess material toughness through Charpy or Izod impact tests

fatigue.name: Fatigue Testing
fatigue.description: Determine fatigue life and endurance limits under cyclic loading

creep.name: Creep Testing
creep.description: Measure time-dependent deformation under constant stress

corrosion.name: Corrosion Testing
corrosion.description: Evaluate corrosion resistance in various environments

scc.name: Stress Corrosion Cracking
scc.description: Test susceptibility to SCC in specific environments

flammability.name: Flammability Testing
flammability.description: Assess material flammability and fire resistance properties

outgassing.name: Outgassing Testing
outgassing.description: Measure volatile emissions for space and vacuum applications

oxygen.name: Oxygen Compatibility
oxygen.description: Evaluate material safety for oxygen service (GOX/LOX)

hydrogen.name: Hydrogen Compatibility
hydrogen.description: Assess hydrogen embrittlement susceptibility and HEE index

thermal.name: Thermal Analysis
thermal.description: Measure thermal conductivity, expansion, and stability

electrical.name: Electrical Properties
electrical.description: Test conductivity, resistivity, and dielectric properties
